changelog: Initial release: SOTA neural machine translation using Cohere's Command A Translate (111B, 23 languages). Free tier available (1,000 calls/month). Features: zero-agent-token file mode, script-density-aware auto-chunking, 6000-token round-trip budget, rate-limit pacing. Zero Python dependencies (stdlib + curl only).
summary: Neural machine translation supporting 23 languages using Cohere's Command A Translate model, optimized for file-based input to minimize token costs.
